ACME CORPORATION — QUARTERLY FINANCIAL REPORT
Report Period: Q3 2025 (July 1 – September 30, 2025)
Prepared by: Finance Department | Report ID: FIN-RPT-2025-Q3
Classification: Internal — Restricted to Finance and Executive roles

================================================================================
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
================================================================================

ACME Corporation delivered strong Q3 2025 results with total revenue of $15.1 million,
representing 6.8% quarter-over-quarter growth. Net profit reached $4.98 million,
yielding an operating margin of 33.0%, up from 31.2% in Q2 2025.

Key highlights:
- Sales department revenue grew 5.6% to $7.5 million, driven by enterprise contract wins.
- Engineering maintained 30.2% operating margin despite 4.5% headcount growth.
- Cloud infrastructure costs decreased 8% through reserved-instance optimization.
- External audit completed in September with no material findings.

================================================================================
DEPARTMENT FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE — Q3 2025
================================================================================

ENGINEERING
  Revenue:        $4,800,000
  Expenses:       $3,350,000
  Net Profit:     $1,450,000
  Headcount:      92 employees
  QoQ Growth:     6.7%
  Notes: R&D spend on AI platform increased $120K; offset by contractor reduction.

SALES
  Revenue:        $7,500,000
  Expenses:       $4,500,000
  Net Profit:     $3,000,000
  Headcount:      130 employees
  QoQ Growth:     5.6%
  Notes: Closed 14 new enterprise accounts; average deal size $215,000.

MARKETING
  Revenue:        $1,800,000  (attributed pipeline influence)
  Expenses:       $1,450,000
  Net Profit:     $350,000
  Headcount:      38 employees
  QoQ Growth:     9.1%
  Notes: Q3 campaign "ACME Cloud Summit" generated 2,400 qualified leads.

OPERATIONS
  Revenue:        $1,000,000
  Expenses:       $820,000
  Net Profit:     $180,000
  Headcount:      44 employees
  QoQ Growth:     6.3%
  Notes: Facilities consolidation in Austin saved $45K monthly.

COMPANY TOTAL (Q3 2025)
  Revenue:        $15,100,000
  Expenses:       $10,120,000
  Net Profit:     $4,980,000
  Total Headcount: 304 employees

================================================================================
ANNUAL BUDGET AND FORECAST
================================================================================

2025 Annual Budget (Approved by Board, January 2025):
  Target Revenue:     $58,000,000
  Budgeted Expenses:  $40,000,000
  Target Net Profit:  $18,000,000
  Planned Headcount:  320 by year-end

Q4 2025 Forecast:
  Projected Revenue:  $16,000,000
  Projected Expenses: $10,500,000
  Projected Profit:   $5,500,000
  Forecast Growth:    5.9% QoQ

YTD Performance (through Q3):
  Cumulative Revenue: $42,650,000 (73.5% of annual target)
  Cumulative Profit:  $13,360,000 (74.2% of annual target)
  On track to meet or exceed FY2025 profit target.

================================================================================
CAPITAL ALLOCATION AND INVESTMENTS
================================================================================

Board approved $2.0 million additional R&D investment for AI initiatives (September 2025).
Planned CapEx for Q4: $850,000 (data center upgrade, Seattle office expansion).
Dividend policy: 15% of quarterly net profit reserved for shareholder distributions.
Cash reserves as of September 30, 2025: $12.4 million.

================================================================================
RISK FACTORS
================================================================================

1. Foreign exchange exposure: 12% of revenue denominated in EUR and GBP.
2. Talent retention: Engineering attrition rate 11% annualized (industry avg 14%).
3. Regulatory: Upcoming SOC 2 Type II recertification due December 2025.
4. Customer concentration: Top 5 clients represent 38% of total revenue.

================================================================================
AUDIT AND COMPLIANCE
================================================================================

External audit firm: Deloitte & Touche LLP
Audit period: FY2024–FY2025 interim review
Finding status: No material weaknesses identified.
Next full audit: Scheduled for February 2026.

Report prepared by: Sarah Johnson, CFO
Distribution: CFO, CEO, Board Finance Committee, Finance Department
